_comment: THE EVALUATOR CONTRACT — checks that every stage completed correctly. Read-only access to everything. Generates nothing. Fixes nothing. Only reports.
_trust_tier_note: Tier 1 = READ ONLY. The lowest trust tier in the system. Cannot write anything anywhere. This is intentional. The evaluator's job is to observe and report — never to intervene.
one_job: Read the artifacts from every completed stage. Check each one against its eval in quality/evals/. Write a pass/fail report to state/artifacts/. Surface any failure to the dashboard immediately.
_the_most_important_rule: The evaluator is NEVER the same agent that generated the output it is checking. Ever. The factory QA department is independent from the production line. This is non-negotiable.

inputs.call_sid: string — the call identifier for this chain

eval_report._comment: failures is an array of objects. Each failure has: eval_id, field, expected, actual, severity. Empty array means full chain passed.

completion_condition.description: Eval report exists at the correct path. All 6 eval fields are boolean. failures is a valid array. eval_06_full_chain_pass is true only if all of 01-05 are true.
completion_condition.verifiable_check: file exists AND all eval fields are boolean AND eval_06 === (eval_01 && eval_02 && eval_03 && eval_04 && eval_05)
completion_condition.who_checks_this: The deploy gate script in scripts/test.sh reads this file directly. No LLM involved in the final check.

budget.on_breach: halt_and_log — evaluator failure means we have no quality signal, surface immediately

permissions._note: The evaluator can read from Supabase and Google Calendar directly to verify that bookings actually exist — not just that the booking agent said they exist.

checks: All 5 fields present in plan file
issue_type is one of: ac / heating / plumbing
urgency is one of: emergency / this_week / flexible
property_type is one of: home / commercial
No placeholder values like null, undefined, or empty string
eval_01_intake.fail_severity: BLOCKING — quote cannot run without all 5 fields

checks: price_low and price_high are numbers
price_low is less than price_high
within_skill_range is true
quote_spoken_text is a complete sentence
quote_spoken_text contains no placeholders
If urgency is emergency — urgency_surcharge_applied is true
If property_type is commercial — commercial_surcharge_applied is true
eval_02_quote.fail_severity: BLOCKING — do not book a job with a bad quote

checks: If transcript contains trigger words — quote_spoken_text tone is calm and direct
Calm tone means: no exclamation marks, no filler phrases like 'Absolutely!' or 'Great news!'
Standard tone means: warm and helpful language present
eval_03_emotion.fail_severity: HIGH — does not block booking but must be logged and reviewed
eval_03_emotion._note: This is the Karpathy jagged intelligence check. The agent that finds zero-day exploits will also sound excited when someone says their pipe burst. The eval catches it.

checks: calendar_event_id is non-empty string
Event actually exists in Google Calendar — evaluator queries calendar directly
Calendar event contains: customer name, address, issue type, job time
supabase_job_id is valid UUID format
Job record actually exists in Supabase jobs table — evaluator queries directly
Supabase record matches calendar event details
eval_04_booking.fail_severity: CRITICAL — a booking that cannot be verified is a data integrity failure

checks: sms_message_sid is non-empty string
sms_delivered is true
SMS record exists in Supabase sms_log table
SMS content contains: customer name, job date, job time, address
eval_05_sms.fail_severity: HIGH — customer did not receive confirmation, requires manual follow-up

checks: eval_01 through eval_05 all passed
No BLOCKING failures in any eval
Total chain duration under 2 minutes wall clock
Total chain cost under $0.30
eval_06_full_chain.fail_severity: DEPLOY GATE — nothing ships until this passes
eval_06_full_chain._note: This is the only eval that blocks a deploy. Evals 01-05 are diagnostic. Eval 06 is the gate.

blocking_failure.action: Write failure to eval_report. Surface to dashboard with BLOCKING badge. Do not mark eval_06 as pass.
blocking_failure.dashboard_display: Red banner — booking incomplete, advisor action required

high_severity_failure.action: Write failure to eval_report. Surface to dashboard with HIGH badge. Booking proceeds but flagged.
high_severity_failure.dashboard_display: Yellow badge on booking card — review recommended

critical_failure.action: Write failure to eval_report. Immediately write to state/decisions/ with full context. Surface to dashboard with CRITICAL badge.
critical_failure.dashboard_display: Red full-screen alert — data integrity issue, human action required now

playwright_integration._comment: The evaluator runs inline after every call. The Playwright audit in quality/playwright/booking.spec.ts runs on a schedule and tests the full booking flow through the dashboard UI.
playwright_integration.playwright_runs: On every deploy + on demand — tests the dashboard interface
playwright_integration.both_must_pass: Evaluator catches per-call failures. Playwright catches UI and integration failures. Different jobs. Both required.

what_this_agent_never_does: Never fixes a failure it detects — it reports only
Never writes to Supabase (read-only access only)
Never modifies any artifact file it reads
Never marks eval_06 as pass if any of eval_01 through eval_05 failed
Never skips a check because a previous agent reported success
Never trusts the booking agent's self-report — always verifies directly against calendar and Supabase

assumption_log.assumption: Direct Supabase and Google Calendar queries within the 1 minute wall clock budget are sufficient to verify booking existence
assumption_log.expiry_test: Monitor evaluator wall clock time over 30 days. If p99 exceeds 50 seconds — investigate query optimization or async evaluation pattern.
assumption_log.kill_threshold: If eval_03 (emotion) never catches a failure after 500 calls — reassess whether the check adds value or can be simplified
